column3: Two creates with the same id failed with chord 'Cannot use a settled overlay'; it was a draft escape, not concurrency: the second create returned the existing tx.doc record from its commit and read its nested when/target after the overlay settled
column4: the first create returned a plain object so it was harmless; instrumenting the throw showed taskOf reading a settled overlay, and pi serialised the commits correctly all along
column6: fixed: taskOf runs inside the commit callback, so a commit returns only primitives; a sequential same-id test pins it
